title: relay_queue: DKIM failure path does not call inc_relay_failure — metrics inconsistent
description: In try_deliver_one, inc_relay_attempt is called before DKIM signing. If signing fails, the function returns early without calling inc_relay_failure. Result: attempt_count increments but failure_count does not — metrics dashboard shows phantom attempts with no corresponding outcomes. Operators monitoring failure rate would miss DKIM failures entirely.
